title.narrative: Contributing to Food Security for refugees and host communities living in Lebanon

description.narrative:
In light of the continuing impacts of the ongoing and multifaceted crises on Lebanese population as well as refugees the Overall Objective (O.O) of the project seeks to contribute to the improvement the living conditions and resilience of host communities and refugees living in Lebanon.

The Project seeks to build the resilience of the most vulnerable through its livelihood and resilience component, implemented jointly by FAO and WFP. This will specifically result in an Increase in the local sustainable production of key agricultural products contributing to food security and import substitution (Specific objective).
